title: 第675章 苍帝退去第674章 战起老六苍帝偷袭沧源
slug: 我定海神珠拐走人族后六圣懵了
content_zh:
苍帝占据了沧源的肉身。
黑红色道袍猎猎作响，苍白的手掌缓缓收拢，感受着这具躯壳里流淌的每一缕力量，白发垂落，赤红色的瞳孔中闪过一道幽深的光。
然而就在祂试图彻底炼化这具身体的瞬间，祂的动作忽然僵住了。
因为祂看到了一颗心脏。
那颗心脏悬浮在沧源的道台中央。
通体剔透如琉璃。
三色神光在其中流转不息，玄黄、苍白、赤红，三种极致的本源之力交织成一种近乎永恒的苍蓝光泽。
而最让苍帝瞳孔骤缩的，是那三光神水散发出的气息。
与那半颗永恒道果完全一致。
苍帝沉默了很久。
祂低头看着那颗无瑕道心，赤红色的瞳孔深处翻涌着难以言喻的复杂情绪。
部分永恒道果的碎片吗？
遗失的另外一半永恒道果的部分碎片。
绝对不会错。
“有趣。”
苍帝的声音从沧源的喉咙中传出，低哑而带着一种难以压制的兴奋。
“永恒道果……本帝穷尽无数纪元都无法参透的东西，哈吉沧你这家伙，竟然藏着一块可参悟运用的永恒道果碎片。”
祂伸出苍白的手指。
悬停在无瑕道心上空。
三光神水的气息如同活物般缠绕上祂的指尖。

部分永恒道果碎片体量极小，大约只占那半颗封印道果的百分之一的体量。
但也正因为体量很小，苍帝才能感受得到其中那层薄薄的、可以被祂驾驭的可能性。
永恒道果不可触碰，不可掌控，不可利用。
完整的永恒道果，苍帝连直视都做不到，否则早就在无数纪元前将那颗被祂封印的道果炼化了。
但眼前这一小部分，如同微尘般细碎的碎片，却刚好在祂能够掌控的尺度之内。
祂的气息微微震荡了一下。
黑暗的诡异源头气息从这具躯体中迸发而出，如同一颗溺死的恒星在虚无中炸裂，将周围正在交战的双方全部震退。
盘古一斧劈开原初之海压来的污染潮汐，脚步骤然一停，回头望去。
苍帝悬浮在战场中央，白发飘散，赤红色的瞳孔中翻涌着兴奋到疯狂的光芒，黑红色道袍猎猎翻卷，眉心的黑色神纹如同活物般蠕动着扩散开来。
整片虚无在这一刻发出沉闷的哀鸣。
大道之下的一切法则都在颤抖。
“本帝已然圆满！”
苍帝的声音猛然炸开，如同一道贯穿无数维度的雷霆，震得虚无翻涌，无乡域壁垒上瞬间出现了数十道蛛网般的裂纹。
“攻克永恒道果……指日可待！”
剑尊横剑而立，青碧长剑发出一声激越的长鸣，他面色极其难看：“他占了沧源小友的肉身，力量似乎又强了一截。”
帝凰的声音中带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖：“他现在的状态很诡异，我推演不到任何信息。”
青帝枯了大半的翠绿枝条重新抽出新芽，生机之力拼命修补着被污染侵蚀的伤势，咬牙道：“他好像要动手了。”
果然。
苍帝猛然抬头，声音中带着一种近乎癫狂的杀意：“不过在此之前……本帝要将你们这些丧家之犬，统统祭掉！”
祂抬起手。

黑红色的污染之力在那只苍白的手掌上凝聚成一颗旋转的毁灭旋涡，黑暗诡异源头的气息在旋涡中疯狂翻涌，整片虚无都开始朝那个方向坍塌。
无乡域壁垒发出刺耳的崩裂声。
三道意志在无乡域内部猛然升腾而起，天道、地道、人道同时催动全部力量稳固壁垒。
content_en:
Cang Emperor took over Cangyuan's body.
The black and red robes made a hunting sound, and the pale palms slowly closed, feeling every ray of power flowing in this body. The white hair fell down, and a deep light flashed in the red pupils.
However, the moment he tried to completely refine this body, his movements suddenly froze.
Because He sees a heart.
The heart is suspended in the center of the Taoist platform in Cangyuan.
The whole body is as clear as glass.
Three colors of divine light flow endlessly in it, dark yellow, pale, and red. The three ultimate sources of power are intertwined into an almost eternal blue luster.
What made Cang Emperor's pupils shrink the most was the aura emanating from the three-light divine water.
It is completely consistent with the half of the eternal Tao fruit.
Emperor Cang was silent for a long time.
He looked down at the flawless Dao Heart, with unspeakable complex emotions surging deep in his red pupils.
Part of the eternal Tao Fruit?
Partial fragments of the other half of the lost eternal Tao Fruit.
You can't go wrong.
"Interesting."
Emperor Cang's voice came out from Cangyuan's throat, low and hoarse with an excitement that was hard to suppress.
"Eternal Dao Fruit... something that I have been unable to understand for countless epochs. You, Haji Cang, actually hide a piece of Eternal Dao Fruit that can be understood and used."
He stretched out his pale fingers.
Hovering over the flawless Taoist heart.
The breath of the three-light divine water wrapped around his fingertips like a living thing.
Some of the Eternal Dao Fruit fragments are extremely small, accounting for only about one percent of the volume of the half sealed Dao Fruit.
But precisely because of its small size, Emperor Cang could feel the thin layer of possibility within it that could be controlled by him.
The eternal Tao Fruit cannot be touched, controlled, or utilized.
Emperor Cang couldn't even look directly at the complete Eternal Dao Fruit, otherwise he would have refined the Dao Fruit sealed by him countless epochs ago.
But this small part in front of him, as fine as dust, is just within the scale that He can control.
His breath shook slightly.
The strange source of darkness burst out from this body, like a drowned star exploding in the void, knocking back all the fighting parties around it.
Pangu split the tide of pollution coming from the primordial sea with an axe. His footsteps suddenly stopped and he looked back.
Emperor Cang was suspended in the center of the battlefield, with his white hair floating around, his crimson pupils gleaming with excitement to the point of madness, his black and red Taoist robes curling up, and the black divine lines between his eyebrows squirming and spreading like living creatures.
The whole void let out a dull wail at this moment.
All laws under the avenue are trembling.
"This emperor has reached perfection!"
Cang Emperor's voice suddenly exploded, like a thunder that penetrated countless dimensions, shaking the void, and dozens of spider web-like cracks instantly appeared on the wall of the No Country.
"Conquering the Eternal Dao Fruit... is just around the corner!"
The sword master stood with his sword horizontally, and the green long sword let out a long and exciting roar. His face was extremely ugly: "He has taken over the body of little friend Cangyuan, and his strength seems to be stronger."
There was an imperceptible tremor in Dihuang's voice: "His current state is very strange, and I can't deduce any information."
Most of the green branches of Qing Emperor had withered and sprouted new sprouts again. With the power of vitality, he desperately repaired the wounds eroded by pollution. He gritted his teeth and said, "It seems he is going to take action."
Sure enough.
Cang Emperor suddenly raised his head, with an almost crazy murderous intent in his voice: "But before that... I will sacrifice all of you lost dogs!"
He raised his hand.
The black-red pollution power condensed into a rotating vortex of destruction on that pale palm. The breath of the dark and strange source surged crazily in the vortex, and the entire void began to collapse in that direction.
The walls of the Homeless Domain made a harsh cracking sound.
Three wills suddenly rose up inside the Wuxiang Realm. The Way of Heaven, the Way of Earth, and the Way of Humanity simultaneously mobilized all their forces to stabilize the barriers.。
